S012 — Targeted closure of the remaining 21 country cases

User instruction: Concentrate on the 21 countries still partial after S011.

Use the frozen S011 baseline (685 office/authority transfers, 103 collective changes, 176 full and 21 partial countries). Keep the event window 11 November 2016–11 November 2026. Assign all 21 partial countries once; investigate their 26 partial office chains and account for all 43 open questions.

Start from the exact remaining proposition and the source routes already tried. Seek original legal instruments, appointment/removal records, complete named and ex-officio rosters, archived official material and reliable contemporary reporting in relevant languages. Open the actual source bodies. Distinguish authority, formal title, membership, actual participation and announcement from operative transfer. Do not repeat settled personal-office research without a reason. Supported legal continuity and date-specific corroboration can establish a sequence; neither absence of search results nor the same two endpoint names establishes completeness. Reconsider excessive evidential demands consistently with the existing protocol, retaining all contrary evidence.

Freeze explicit proposals with source URLs, actual supported claims, failures and remaining uncertainty. Have a different agent open supporting evidence for every new or changed factual claim and every coverage promotion. Adjudicate disagreements before integration. Unknown dates may remain bounded when the count and order are established. Count/grouping uncertainty remains unresolved. Preserve stable IDs, separate office/authority transfers from collective membership changes, and do not change the adopted scope to obtain zero partials.

Integrate only reviewed changes, derive country status from all relevant chains, update linked questions and notes, and keep wording clear, concise and neutral. Update the existing workbook, report, research archive and atlas, preserving Mechanism as the initial and Reset view and the existing audience. Validate changed data, source preservation, counts, Office files and affected website behavior. Preserve the S011 baseline and all historical evidence. Report actual progress for each of the 21 cases and the precise documentary obstacles remaining. Do not claim universal full coverage unless all relevant chains meet the standard.
